description: Withdrawn by August 1988 and used for ground instruction at No.1 SoTT Halton as 8974M coded 33, later with the Air UK apprentice school at Norwich Airport and Bedford College, then Everett Aero at Sproughton in 2007. Now privately owned and displayed outdoors on Toppesfield Road beside the former RAF Wethersfield airfield. Last recorded present April 2021.
